title: Compose a one-trillion-token source mixture
description: Choose a product goal, then rebalance source families. Watch capability signals, governance confidence, duplicate exposure, and concentration move together.
note: This is an illustrative planning model, not a benchmark. Replace the scores with measurements from licensed samples and pilot training runs.
